name: study-microbit-with-test
description: micro:bit 学習プロジェクト

scripts.lint:python: cd sample-compass && uv run python -m py_compile compass.py conftest.py && echo '✓ Python OK'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:makecode
scripts.test:python: cd sample-compass && uv run pytest test_compass.py test_build_hex.py -v
scripts.integration:python: cd sample-compass && uv run pytest test_compass_integration.py -v
scripts.build:hex:python: cd sample-compass && uv run python build_hex.py
scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run test:python && npm run test:ts && npm run test:makecode
scripts.integration: npm run integration:python && npm run integration:ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run integration && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:python && npm run test:coverage:ts
scripts.build:hex: npm run build:hex:python && npm run build:hex:makecode
